response.sql: WITH telescope_counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), shares AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, 100.0 * telescope_count / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share_pct FROM telescope_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share_pct) AS share_pct FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.telescope_count) AS total_telescopes, AVG(s.share_pct) AS average_share_pct, AVG(s.share_pct - a.share_pct) AS average_excess_pct FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE s.share_pct > a.share_pct
